scripts.build: bun build --target=browser --outdir=dist src/content.ts src/background.ts src/injected.ts src/utils.ts --minify && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json
scripts.dev: bun build --target=browser --outdir=dist --watch src/content.ts src/background.ts src/injected.ts src/utils.ts & cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json
